attrib: Yemen's Houthis claimed a ballistic-missile strike on the Ras Tanura refinery (as reported); Saudi authorities report only intercepting 3 missiles aimed at the Eastern Province and have not confirmed a hit
name: Ras Tanura refinery & export terminal
status: Fire near the hub reported contained; extent of damage and any disruption to refining or exports unclear
summary: On 27 Oct a fire near Aramco's Ras Tanura hub was reported contained after an attack, per Bloomberg and maritime security firm Vanguard (cited by Gulf News). The Houthi claim of a direct hit causing 'massive fires' is unverified; Saudi statements mention only interceptions.
